facts.text: A Copland (owner, applicant) and Southland District Council (authority) dispute an amendment to a building consent to use uPVC window and door joinery for a house at 101 Copland Road, Waimumu, Gore.
The uPVC joinery scope covers windows and doors, fixings and supports, flashings, junctions with adjacent walls and claddings, and how the components are intended to be installed and work together.
The authority's concerns are in respect of Clauses B1, B2 and E2 only; other amendments to the consent are not considered.
